question: What is the year of independence of Brunei?
sql: SELECT graph.IndepYear FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (country:Country) WHERE country.Name = ''Brunei'' RETURN country.IndepYear AS IndepYear') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(IndepYear INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (country:Country) WHERE country.Name = ''Brunei'' RETURN country.IndepYear AS IndepYear')

question: How many countries have no GNP?
sql: SELECT graph.count FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (country:Country) WHERE country.GNP = 0 RETURN count(*)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(count INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (country:Country) WHERE country.GNP = 0 RETURN count(*)')

question: What is the average surface area of all countries?
sql: SELECT graph.SurfaceArea FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (country:Country) RETURN avg(country.SurfaceArea)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(SurfaceArea DOUBLE PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (country:Country) RETURN avg(country.SurfaceArea)')

question: How many languages are there in the country where Tocantins district belongs?
sql: SELECT graph.countDISTINCT FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (t1:City)<-[countrycode:COUNTRYCODE]-(t2:CountryLanguage) WHERE t1.District = ''Tocantins'' RETURN count(DISTINCT t2.Language)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(countDISTINCT INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (t1:City)<-[countrycode:COUNTRYCODE]-(t2:CountryLanguage) WHERE t1.District = ''Tocantins'' RETURN count(DISTINCT t2.Language)')

question: How many cities are there in the country ruled by Kostis Stefanopoulos?
sql: SELECT graph.countDISTINCT FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (t1:City)<-[code:CODE]-(t2:Country) WHERE t2.HeadOfState = ''Kostis Stefanopoulos'' RETURN count(DISTINCT t1.Name)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(countDISTINCT INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (t1:City)<-[code:CODE]-(t2:Country) WHERE t2.HeadOfState = ''Kostis Stefanopoulos'' RETURN count(DISTINCT t1.Name)')

question: What is the life expectancy of the countries that uses Japanese as their language?
sql: SELECT graph.LifeExpectancy FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('world', 'MATCH (t1:CountryLanguage)<-[code:CODE]-(t2:Country) WHERE t1.Language = ''Japanese'' RETURN avg(t2.LifeExpectancy)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(LifeExpectancy DOUBLE PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
